repairs.description: Crossan argues that Israel’s prophecies voiced broad hopes for divine justice, later applied to Jesus through faith rather than fulfilled as specific prior predictions.
repairs.rationale: Recasts the proposition and inference as one complete sentence while preserving the distinction between broad scriptural hope and specific prediction.

repairs.description: White argues that miracles selectively authenticate Jesus and need not recur routinely, because their specific revelatory purpose explains departures from ordinary processes without implying divine absence.
repairs.rationale: Combines the selective-sign claim with its explanation of nonrepetition and ordinary-process departures without adding evidence or judgment.
